candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily maximum temperature (temperature_2m_max) from ERA5 reanalysis. Covers full period 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31. CC-BY-4.0, no API key. Registered and approved for UC2.
suspected_issues: ERA5 grid interpolation may differ from ground-station readings
Must choose specific northern-Italy location — document assumption

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
